gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Commanding and a bit cheeky, Righteous fills every line with big bowls drawn like bent steel rod. Noto Sans Medefaidrin is the plain sans beneath it, and its tall lowercase gives the text a steady, contemporary footing.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Fun and commanding, Righteous bends one thin rod into every letter. Make that heading small, or the Noto Sans Meetei Mayek body large, and you notice how the body's cracked-bangle rounds and big lowercase eyes soften the heading's hard, uniform lines.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight into every curve while its lowercase stands tall against the capitals. Righteous, drawn like bent wire, supplies the swagger.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Bold bowls, wire-thin strokes, zero fuss. Noto Sans Meroitic follows in a friendly sans whose lowercase fills the line like capitals, giving Righteous a roomy partner that never competes.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi lets daylight into every curve, with lowercase sitting close to capital height. Righteous is the one for swagger, its bent-wire strokes filling the line, but the body font is the one that keeps words easy to follow.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-mono: Righteous draws its big, rounded letters with rod-stock uniformity, every horizontal and vertical identical in thickness. Noto Sans Mono, in turn, makes words look sturdy, with generous spacing and openings.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-mro: Dense and tall through the middle, Noto Sans Mro makes words look sturdy, with large entrances into each letter. Noto Sans Mro would carry a long passage with a modern, steady feel, while Righteous stays with its hairline-free bowls up top.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-multani: Righteous looks poured at a single width, its bowls swelling to fill the whole line with commanding fun. Noto Sans Multani adds a lofty x-height and a wide-gapped e, and that gap is the pair's best trick.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Righteous looks laser-cut from sheet, every stroke one width and every bowl filling its line. Noto Sans Myanmar then lays a thick, heavy-looking strip of text beneath it, with a broad, welcoming c.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Noto Sans Nabataean reads with lowercase standing almost cap-tall and wide-open s curves, contemporary and sturdy. And Righteous, drawn as if with a compass pencil, gives it a commanding, playful headline.
